title: Copy the vflow UI parts into the workspace

directory.description: A directory where the parts are placed. Overrides componentsPath of vflow.json.

importAlias.description: The import alias of the parts on the first run, e.g. @acme/flow-ui. Asked for when omitted.

buildable.description: Nx only: whether the library of the parts gets a build target on the first run. Asked for when omitted.
